adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the prior `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]) ...)` call is removed and replaced with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` fetches and parses the remote page via `open(url).read` and does not pass any `created_at` into `PostCreator` inside `TopicEmbed.import`, so imported posts/topics will get the current timestamp rather than the original `t[:created_at]`. Also, because `open(url).read`/Readability parsing are not wrapped in any rescue, an unreachable/unparseable thread URL will raise and can abort the import rather than still creating a placeholder topic/post as before.
